issues.display_title: Issue #59: [Feature] Clean Context Namespacing & Interactive Client Action Button Dispatcher
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Enable the RAG chat widget to safely capture page context alongside conversation history and render interactive Call-To-Action (CTA) buttons that dispatch native events to the host GoThru dashboard.

Key Changes

  • Separate chat request payload context into history and page namespaces in src/components/Chat.tsx to prevent data collision.
  • Render interactive Call-to-Action (CTA) buttons in src/components/ChatLog.tsx when client_action is received from the RAG backend.
  • Dispatch native gothru:action CustomEvent to the dashboard when the button is clicked: 
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('gothru:action', { detail: msg.client_action }));
  • Keep the CTA button active for repeatable user interactions.

Part of Epic: GoThruMedia/gothru-rag#TBD GoThruMedia/gothru-rag#29

issues.display_title: Issue #60: [Feature] Countly Analytics Tracking for Client Actions (Namespaced & Categorized)
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Integrate Countly analytics tracking for RAG Client Actions (CTA button clicks and auto-triggers).

This integration leverages the existing GoThru Dashboard Countly instance and App Key, while isolating and categorizing all RAG-related analytics using dedicated event namespaces (rag_*) and segmentation metadata (feature: 'rag_copilot', source: 'rag_widget') so data can be independently filtered and visualized in Countly without polluting core dashboard metrics.

Tracking Design & Event Schema

1. Event Namespace & Segmentation

All events must be prefixed with rag_ and include standardized categorization:

Event Name Trigger Condition Segmentation Properties
rag_client_action_offered Assistant returns response containing client_action feature: "rag_copilot", source: "rag_widget", action: string, target: string, auto_trigger: boolean
rag_client_action_triggered User clicks CTA button in chat OR action is executed via auto_trigger feature: "rag_copilot", source: "rag_widget", action: string, target: string, trigger_type: "manual_click" | "auto"

2. Privacy & Safety Boundaries

  • Allowed: feature, source, action, target, trigger_type, label.
  • Disallowed: No user tokens, auth headers, search queries/prompt texts, session IDs, or arbitrary payload params.

Technical Approach

  1. Countly Dispatcher Helper (src/lib/countly.ts):

    • Provide a safe tracking function trackRagEvent(eventName, segmentation).
    • Safely delegate to existing window.Countly if running inside gothru-dashboard, or initialize standalone Countly SDK if credentials (VITE_COUNTLY_URL / data-countly-url) are provided.
    • Graceful fallback: If Countly is unavailable or blocked by ad blockers, fail silently without disrupting chat interactions.

  2. Component Instrumentation:

    • src/components/Chat.tsx: Emit rag_client_action_offered upon receiving client_action, and rag_client_action_triggered with trigger_type: "auto" when auto_trigger === true.
    • src/components/ChatLog.tsx: Emit rag_client_action_triggered with trigger_type: "manual_click" inside the CTA button click handler prior to dispatching gothru:action.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Events are recorded under the existing dashboard App Key with the rag_ prefix and feature: 'rag_copilot' segment.
  • AI responses containing client_action emit rag_client_action_offered.
  • Clicking a CTA button in ChatLog records rag_client_action_triggered with trigger_type: "manual_click".
  • Auto-triggered actions record rag_client_action_triggered with trigger_type: "auto".
  • No PII or raw user prompt data is included in event payloads.
  • Missing or blocked Countly does not cause errors or impede chat functionality.

Part of Epic: GoThruMedia/gothru-rag#29
